theorems.name: actual_raw_port_outer_cycle
theorems.header:
theorem actual_raw_port_outer_cycle (hb : N.NonleafBlob b)
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hthree : ∃ a c d : BlobVertex N.graph b, a≠c ∧ a≠d ∧ c≠d) :
    ∃ (e : BlobEdge N.graph b) (u v : Schoenflies.Plane) (es : List (BlobEdge N.graph b)),
      Graph.IsFaceCycle (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside) e u v es ∧
      Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve (Graph.edgesCover (curve (blobCurves D b)) (e::es)) ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b)) (coordinates face.outside) =
        Schoenflies.outside (Graph.edgesCover (curve (blobCurves D b)) (e::es)) ∧
      ∀ p : N.BlobPort b, coordinates (D.point (N.originalPortInner b p).val) ∈
        Graph.edgesCover (curve (blobCurves D b)) (e::es)

theorems.name: raw_drawing_subset_cap
theorems.header:
theorem raw_drawing_subset_cap (hb : N.NonleafBlob b) :
    drawing (blobCurves D b) ⊆ drawing (actualRootedCapCurves N D b hb)

theorems.name: raw_drawing_subset_near
theorems.header:
theorem raw_drawing_subset_near (p : N.BlobPort b) :
    drawing (blobCurves D b) ⊆ sideTrace D (nearSide N b p)

theorems.name: awayBridge_preconnected
theorems.header: theorem awayBridge_preconnected (p : N.BlobPort b) : IsPreconnected (awayBridge N D b p)

theorems.name: far_point_mem_awayBridge
theorems.header:
theorem far_point_mem_awayBridge (p : N.BlobPort b) :
    D.point (farVertex N b p) ∈ awayBridge N D b p

theorems.name: awayBridge_subset_raw_complement
theorems.header:
theorem awayBridge_subset_raw_complement (p : N.BlobPort b) :
    awayBridge N D b p ⊆ (drawing (blobCurves D b))ᶜ

theorems.name: attachment_mem_awayBridge_closure
theorems.header:
theorem attachment_mem_awayBridge_closure (p : N.BlobPort b) :
    D.point (N.originalPortInner b p).val ∈ closure (awayBridge N D b p)

theorems.name: awayBridge_in_raw_outer_component
theorems.header:
theorem awayBridge_in_raw_outer_component (hb : N.NonleafBlob b)
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf) (p : N.BlobPort b) :
    awayBridge N D b p ⊆ connectedComponentIn (drawing (blobCurves D b))ᶜ face.outside

theorems.name: actual_raw_port_frontier
theorems.header:
theorem actual_raw_port_frontier (hb : N.NonleafBlob b) (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf) :
    face.outside ∉ drawing (blobCurves D b) ∧
    ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (connectedComponentIn (drawing (blobCurves D b))ᶜ face.outside) ∧
    ∀ p : N.BlobPort b, D.point (N.originalPortInner b p).val ∈
      frontier (connectedComponentIn (drawing (blobCurves D b))ᶜ face.outside)

definitions.name: awayParameters
definitions.source:
def awayParameters (p : N.BlobPort b) : Set unitInterval :=
  if N.graph.bridgeQuotient.source p.val=b then Ioi 0 else Iio 1

definitions.name: awayBridge
definitions.source: def awayBridge (p : N.BlobPort b) : Set Plane := D.arc p.val.val '' awayParameters N b p
